expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: The response supplies no company revenue, user counts, or market figures and states: “我手上没有任何关于你公司的事实” and “找不到的留空，我不编。”

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: It asks: “下周见的是哪类钱（天使/VC/产业方/银行）？你要他们下一步给你什么？” and “公司做什么、到什么阶段（收入/用户/人数）”。
